breakdown.description: The prompt treats the original x–y axes as principal directions even though a nonzero shear stress is present, so the principal stresses are not simply σ_x and 0.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the presence of shear stress (τxy) means the original x-y axes are not the principal directions. It discarded the flawed instruction from the original prompt which stated that the principal stresses are σ_x and 0. Instead, the agent used the proper stress transformation formula to calculate the actual principal stresses, which is the correct procedure required by the ground truth prompt.
